principle: Numerical integration time is distinct from persistent WORLD_HISTORY time. Candidate integration is temporary and cannot mutate canonical history.

INTERNAL_DT.meaning: Temporary numerical integration increment selected by an authorized model/controller.

CANDIDATE_SIMULATION_WINDOW.meaning: Temporary interval explored from an identified canonical checkpoint.

REFINEMENT_WINDOW.meaning: Bounded temporal and optionally spatial sub-scope replayed at increased resolution to reduce refinable uncertainty.

PERSISTENT_STATE_INTERVAL.meaning: Spacing between extracted canonical states/checkpoints after trajectory adjudication.

candidate_trajectory.samples: S0..Sn are temporary candidate samples, not DomainState records and not canonical states by virtue of being computed.
minimum_replay_metadata: ordered forcing and event predicate identities
numerical method/configuration and accepted/rejected step decisions
refinement decisions and parent/child scope bindings
expected extracted state and payload identities
candidate_trajectory.storage_rule: Do not retain every sample if deterministic replay with closed, verifiable inputs reproduces the declared outputs; retain samples when required to establish governed tolerances or replay closure.

authority_and_refinement_rule.irreducible_unknown_action: Preserve UNKNOWN and stop or isolate only the affected authorized scope; request a new model/authority decision where needed.

adaptive_controller.growth_rule: Increase INTERNAL_DT only when stability, error, event, significance, uncertainty, dependency and authority checks support it.
adaptive_controller.shrink_rule: Decrease INTERNAL_DT or request local refinement when governed criteria require it.
adaptive_controller.upper_bound_rule: INTERNAL_DT must never exceed the tightest applicable authorized model/authority bound. A revalidation horizon is not reinterpreted as an event-free interval.
adaptive_controller.unbound_threshold_behavior: Do not invent a physical constant or threshold; preserve UNKNOWN and block/isolate the affected scope.

workflow: retain the bracket and predicate evidence
adjudicate event timing/impact with governed uncertainty
emit event candidate or preserve UNKNOWN
event_detection.exact_event_time: Never fabricate a point time; record a bracket/time interval plus confidence/uncertainty and provenance unless governing evidence supports greater precision.
event_detection.event_without_state: Permitted. Event occurrence and event-impact significance remain distinct; EVENT_ONLY may persist in the event ledger without state/checkpoint creation.

local_refinement.isolation_rule: Use an explicit refinement child branch and proven dependency closure. Local refinement does not recompute or mutate the global parent.
local_refinement.global_effect_rule: Publish an effect beyond the child scope only after causal propagation across dependency boundaries is governed and demonstrated.

canonicalization.failure_behavior: A failed candidate, unresolved required authority, failed extraction, or incomplete replay closure publishes nothing; canonical WORLD_HISTORY remains unchanged.
canonicalization.transaction_mechanism: Existing B0-C HistoryStore.append_transaction or branch-scoped append_refinement_transaction; no mutation API is introduced.
canonicalization.read_view_requirement: Readers observe either the prior committed view or the complete accepted publication, never a partial bundle.

architecture_can: bracket and locally refine a transition
persist events and sparse states without advance knowledge of exact event time
